Hi Lee, straight answer: the MGW310 is sold out right now and we have no units on the way yet. Georges is chasing the manufacturer for a restock, so I can't give you a date.

What's in stock is the Wingbits WB200 at $475. It tracks aircraft the same way, but it's ADS-B only, so no RTK and no GEOD earnings like the MGW310 gives you.

Want me to put the WB200 in a cart, or would you rather I have Georges tell you the moment the MGW310 is back?
Handed to the team · Needs Georges for the MGW310 restock answer and the discount code question.

Understood, Lee. I've put your name down with Georges for the MGW310, so you'll hear as soon as he has the restock answer from the manufacturer. He'll jump into this chat, so stay here if you can, and if you step away it comes to you by email.

I also passed on your question about the discount code from the review, so he can settle both in one go.

Great, that's all set then. Georges has it and will come back to you here on both the MGW310 and the code.

If anything else comes up in the meantime, just write here. You're also welcome in our Discord for product news and help: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf
